profile.bio:
I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Educational Leadership and Policy at The University of Texas at Austin. My scholarship examines systemic inequities in education, with a focus on parenting and educational equity across K–12 and higher education, to advance more equitable policies and practices for marginalized families and communities.

I draw on qualitative methodologies to examine parenting and equity in education (1. immigrant parental engagement; 2. parenting students on university campus), social capital and networks in education, school leadership and policy, community-driven educational equity.

research.title: Parenting & Educational Equity
research.description: Parenting experiences, engagement, and educational opportunities across K–12 and higher education, particularly among families marginalized by language, race, class, and immigration status.

research.title: Educational Leadership & Policy
research.description: How educational leadership, institutional practices, and policies shape educational equity and opportunities for marginalized students, families, and communities.

research.title: Social Capital & Community-Driven Equity in Education
research.description: How families and communities build and mobilize social networks, resources, and partnerships to navigate educational systems and challenge systemic inequities.

dissertation.title: Understanding Newcomer Immigrant Parental Engagement within U.S. Secondary Schools
dissertation.description: A qualitative case study exploring newcomer parents’ engagement experiences, the role of social capital, and how educational institutions support or constrain engagement. The study centers newcomer parents' perspectives and attends to relationships among schools, families, and community organizations.
